title: Calculate Average
description: Write a function that calculates the average of a vector of numbers. The average is the sum of all numbers divided by how many numbers there are.
instructions: Complete the calculate_average function so it returns the average as a double.
hints: Add up all the numbers first, then divide by how many there are.
Use numbers.size() to get the count of elements.
Make sure to cast to double before dividing to avoid integer division.
